accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Mail accounts connected to Naushen Mail. Threads are never merged across accounts.

empty.title: No accounts connected
empty.body: Connect Gmail to start reading mail, or add a demo account to explore Naushen Mail offline.
empty.body_outlook: Connect Gmail or Outlook to start reading mail, or add a demo account to explore Naushen Mail offline.

accounts.browserNote: A browser window opened for sign-in. Come back here when you are done; this times out after five minutes.
accounts.openAdvanced: Open the advanced Google client settings

row.noPhoto: No profile photo yet. If {{company}} has one for this account, use Reauthorize to allow reading your profile.
row.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect {{email}}? Its mail, labels and local reminders are removed from Naushen Mail on this computer. Nothing is deleted from {{provider}}.

oauth.wizardTitle: Set up Gmail with your own Google client
oauth.advancedTitle: Advanced: use your own Google client
oauth.intro: Naushen Mail has no backend, so Gmail needs a Google OAuth client that you create yourself. It is free and takes about ten minutes. The values are stored only on this computer and are sent nowhere except to Google. The demo account works without any of this.
oauth.intro_outlook: Naushen Mail has no backend, so you own the OAuth apps (free, about ten minutes each). These values are stored only on this Mac and are sent nowhere except to Google and Microsoft. The demo account works without any of this.
oauth.introBuiltIn: Naushen Mail already includes a Google connection, so you can connect Gmail without any setup. Only use your own client if you prefer to. It is free and takes about ten minutes; the values are stored only on this computer.
oauth.guideLink: Read the full provider setup guide (Gmail)
oauth.guideLink_outlook: Read the full provider setup guide (Gmail and Outlook)
oauth.secretHint: Google treats a desktop-app secret as non-confidential, but the token endpoint still requires it.

project.title: Create a Google Cloud project
project.body: Sign in to Google Cloud Console and create a new project, for example “Naushen Mail”. It is free and needs no billing.

api.title: Enable the Gmail API
api.body: In your new project, open the Gmail API page and click Enable.

consent.title: Set up the consent screen
consent.body: Google Auth Platform → Get started. Use the app name below, your own email as the support and contact address, and choose the External audience.

scopes.title: Add the Gmail permission
scopes.body: Data Access → Add or remove scopes → paste these under “Manually add scopes” → Add to table → Update → Save.

testUser.title: Add yourself as a test user
testUser.body: Audience → Test users → Add users → enter your own Gmail address (or addresses). Only listed users can sign in while the app is in Testing.

client.title: Create the desktop client
client.body: Clients → Create client → Application type: Desktop app → Create. Google then shows a Client ID and a Client secret.

paste.title: Paste the Client ID and secret
paste.body: Copy both values here. They are stored only on this computer and are sent nowhere except to Google.
paste.connectHint: Enter a valid Client ID and the secret to enable the button.

expiry.title: Stop the 7-day sign-out (recommended)
expiry.body: While the consent screen is in Testing, Google expires your sign-in every 7 days and you will need to click Reauthorize. To avoid that, open Audience and choose Publish app so it is In production. You do not need Google’s verification for personal use: Google only shows an “unverified app” warning at sign-in (Advanced → Go to Naushen Mail).

microsoft.title: Microsoft (Outlook)
microsoft.adminNote: Work or school tenants may require admin consent for some permissions; personal accounts do not.

microsoft.register: In Microsoft Entra: App registrations → New registration.
microsoft.name: Name it “Naushen Mail”. Supported account types: Accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts.
microsoft.redirect: Redirect URI: platform Public client/native (mobile & desktop), value:
microsoft.copyId: Copy the Application (client) ID into the field above.
microsoft.public: Authentication → Allow public client flows → Yes.
microsoft.permissions: API permissions → Add → Microsoft Graph → Delegated:
microsoft.noSecret: Do not create a client secret. Naushen Mail is a public client and uses PKCE.

about.title: About
about.blurb: A calm, keyboard-first desktop mail client for Gmail. Your mail is cached on this computer and account tokens are kept in the {{store}}. Naushen Mail has no servers of its own and no AI features.
about.blurb_outlook: A calm, keyboard-first desktop mail client for Gmail and Outlook. Your mail is cached on this computer and account tokens are kept in the {{store}}. Naushen Mail has no servers of its own and no AI features.
about.openSource: Open-source software, used under its own licences.

privacy.label: Privacy Policy
privacy.desc: What Naushen Mail stores and where

appearance.title: Appearance & inbox
appearance.description: How Naushen Mail looks and how the inbox behaves.

language.label: Language
language.desc: The language of the app. “System default” follows your operating system.

theme.label: Theme
theme.desc: Follow macOS, or pick light or dark. Changes apply immediately.

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.desc: More breathing room in the list, sidebar and reader

compact.label: Compact
compact.desc: Tighter rows — more conversations on screen

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.desc: Selection, focus, unread dots and primary buttons.

counts.label: Unread count display
counts.desc: How unread badges in the sidebar are shown. The cap shows 99+ once a view has more than 99 unread.

side.label: Side peek
side.desc: Opens from the right, over the list

center.label: Center peek
center.desc: A centered popup over the list

listCount.label: Show email count next to view title
listCount.desc: Shows how many conversations are in the current list, to the right of the title (Inbox, Categories, …). Off by default.

groupByDate.label: Group by date
groupByDate.desc: Group threads under Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days and so on.

markRead.label: Mark as read when opened
markRead.desc: A thread becomes read as soon as you open it.

remoteImages.label: Block remote images
remoteImages.desc: Images in email are loaded only when you allow them. Protects against tracking pixels.

hideCategories.label: Hide Promotions/Social/Updates/Forums from Inbox
hideCategories.desc: Gmail only. Keeps the Inbox to Primary mail; the rest stays one click away under Categories in the sidebar. Off by default — nothing changes until you turn this on.

avatars.label: Show avatars
avatars.desc: Sender and recipient photos in the thread list and reader, via Gravatar. Off by default — Notion Mail didn't show them either, and it's one more thing pinging an outside service per contact.

swipe.label: Swipe gestures
swipe.desc: Two-finger swipe on a conversation: left archives, right sets a reminder. Trackpads only.

autoAdvance.label: Auto-advance
autoAdvance.desc: Where to go after you archive, trash or snooze the open thread.

undo.label: Undo send
undo.desc: Hold each message for a moment after you press Send, so you can take it back.

notifications.label: Desktop notifications
notifications.desc: Show a macOS notification when new mail arrives in your inbox. Bursts are grouped into one; nothing fires while you are looking at that inbox.

dock.label: Dock badge
dock.desc: Show the number of unread Inbox messages on the Dock icon.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Naushen Mail is built to be driven from the keyboard. Shortcuts are fixed for now.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Labels sync with your account. Colours are local to Naushen Mail.
labels.noAccountsBody: Connect an account to manage its labels.
labels.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? It is removed from every conversation and from the account itself.

views.title: Views
views.description: Saved filters that appear in the sidebar. Drag to reorder.

empty.title: No saved views
empty.body: A view is a saved filter, like “Unread” or “From my team”. It shows up in the sidebar.

views.deleteConfirm: Delete the view “{{name}}”? Your mail is not affected.

snippets.title: Snippets
snippets.description: Reusable text you can insert into any message. Stored on this Mac.
snippets.saveFailed: Couldn’t save snippets (local storage is unavailable).

empty.title: No snippets yet
empty.body: Save the things you type again and again: availability, directions, a polite decline.

snippets.shortcutHint: Optional. Type the shortcut after “/” in the composer to insert this snippet.
snippets.deleteConfirm: Delete this snippet? This can’t be undone.

signature.title: Signature
signature.description: Added to the bottom of new messages. Each account has its own signature.
signature.noAccountsBody: Connect an account first; each account has its own signature.

inReplies.label: Include in replies and forwards
inReplies.desc: When off, the signature is only added to new messages.
inReplies.aria: Include signature in replies and forwards

signature.templatesIntro: Start from a common layout, then edit the placeholder text like any other part of the signature.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.description: Just your name and title — no photo.

photo-left.label: Photo left
photo-left.description: A circular photo beside your name, title and email.

compact.label: Compact
compact.description: Name, title and phone on a single line.

classic.label: Classic block
classic.description: Name, title, company, a divider, then contact info.

signature.replaceConfirm: Replace your current signature with {{name}}? This can't be undone.

photo.title: Signature photo
photo.hasImage: Shown beside your name. Pictures are cropped to a square and shrunk to fit.
photo.noImage: No picture yet, so your initial is shown. Add one to appear beside your name.
photo.badType: Choose a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image.
photo.unreadable: That file could not be read as an image.

signature.placeholder: Write a signature, e.g. your name and title…

preview.title: Preview
preview.subject: Subject: Following up
preview.body: Thanks for the quick call today. I’ll send the notes over tomorrow morning.
